question: In relation to Hereditary Spherocytosis it is true that:

options.opa: It is a congenital hemolytic anemia of inheritance linked to the X chromosome that causes severe anemia.
options.opb: It is characterized by a decrease in osmotic fragility.
options.opc: It manifests as episodes of acute medication anemia.
options.opd: Splenectomy is the treatment of choice when it is symptomatic.
options.ope: It is rarely associated with cholelithiasis.
